answer: Picture every identity as a vertex in an attestation web. Honest agents scatter across the network like wildflowers in a meadow, endorsed by strangers; a sybil farm clusters into a tight island in the ocean of nodes, its vertices all vouching for each other. Measuring how inbred a vertex's endorsements are — high internal degree, no outside edges — flags the cluster, and its self-dealing votes are discounted before they tip any reward.
